messages:
Sofia (Finance): Heads-up — Channel partner 'MercuryChannels' reports a large customer chargeback that AWS routed to them, and they're asking us to hold remittance while they dispute. Net settlement withholding is ~$12,400 for Apr. They asked us to place funds in escrow rather than issue a credit. @Eli can you confirm partner contract allowance?
Eli (PartnerOps): Contract has a clause for dispute escrow but requires RM approval and a signed escrow agreement. Partner asked for immediate action to avoid passing the short-pay to their SMB customer. They sent the dispute note.
BillingBot: Automated payout notification: settlement hold detected for mercury-channels acct on 2026-04-28. Case with AWS payments: 06-223311. Estimated hold amount: 12400.00 USD.
Hannah (Accounting): Hold remittance >$10k requires Revenue Manager sign-off and legal escrow paperwork. If we hold funds we must book a liability 'customer_dispute_escrow' (GL 4505) and not recognize revenue for withheld amount. Need direction: put on escrow or issue provisional credit?
Sofia (Finance): Proposal: place $12,400 in escrow liability account 4505 and mark the partner settlement as 'pending_dispute' so we don't remit. Require RM approval and partner-signed escrow. We'll require AWS case link.
Mark (Revenue Manager): Approve holding funds in escrow pending dispute resolution, up to $15k. Condition: escrow agreement signed by partner, AWS case link attached, legal OK. Approve: Mark +1.
Eli (PartnerOps): Sent partner email requesting signed escrow agreement; partner replied 'signed' and attached doc. They agree to indemnify for fees if dispute fails.
Sofia (Finance): Created FIN-3418: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3418. Booked provisional liability 4505 for $12,400 and paused payout. Attached partner-signed escrow and AWS case 06-223311. Added 15-business-day follow-up.
BillingBot: System update: AWS payments case 06-223311 is open; expected response 7-12 business days.
Hannah (Accounting): Posted journal entry template: Dr Cash clearing, Cr customer_dispute_escrow 4505. Will finalize when legal confirms the escrow doc.
Eli (PartnerOps): Legal confirmed escrow doc. Sent partner confirmation that funds are held in escrow and will be released per case outcome. Partner replied: 'Thanks — appreciate the quick help.'
Sofia (Finance): Closing loop for now. Will update FIN-3418 when AWS responds and reopen if any change. :white_check_mark:
